lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ho₂P₄ (HoP₂) crystallizes in the triclinic space group P1, with a unit cell containing six atoms across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ho centers with nine P neighbors (3.15–3.45 Å) and P centers with ten neighbors (3.15–3.55 Å), with one P environment identified as a 2-neighbor motif. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates corner- and edge-sharing between Ho 9-vertex and P 10-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing among P 10-vertex polyhedra.
